visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white button-up shirt, sits at a wooden table in a room with warm wooden walls and framed nature prints. She smiles and presents a circular 'Mini Verse' toy sphere to the camera. (2) She uses both hands to peel off the plastic outer packaging of the sphere. The camera zooms in as she reveals the different compartments inside the toy. (3) She unpacks several miniature items from the sphere, including a tiny black cauldron, a small wooden crate, and various sealed ingredient packets. She holds each item up for the camera to see. (4) She displays a paper guide showing various potion bottle designs. She uses her fingers to point to different illustrations on the sheet while looking at the camera. (5) In a close-up, she shows a small transparent glass bottle, a tiny container of blue glitter, and small golden crystals on the table. (6) She begins the crafting process by pouring blue glitter resin from a small bottle into the miniature cauldron. She then uses tweezers to add the golden crystals into the blue mixture. (7) She stirs the shimmering blue substance in the cauldron with a small rod. The camera captures the thick, gel-like texture of the mixture in an extreme close-up. (8) She pours the prepared potion from the cauldron into the tiny glass bottle using a miniature funnel. She carefully adjusts the label and adds a small charm to the bottle. (9) She carries the bottle to a window and places it on a ledge. Outside the window, a snowy landscape is visible. An animated clock graphic appears over the shot to indicate waiting time. (10) She returns to the desk and presents the finished potion. It is now solid and sparkling. She holds it close to her face and gestures toward the camera.
